archetypes.name: dyn-oos-redaction
archetypes.rationale: Manifest OOS text sanitization now fails closed in Python and needs security-focused review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed Python materialization path in file_oos.py and its tests for redaction and security routing parity. Focus on whether internal URL, PII, and primary redactor failure cases can leak into public OOS artifacts. Check that security-routed observations remain private and dedupe only exact security-audit headings. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-dispatch-bail
archetypes.rationale: Step 2 now evaluates two in-process materialization passes without subprocess return codes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review implement_dispatch.py and test_implement_dispatch.py for Step 2 materialize-manifest OOS bail semantics. Focus on count-only failures, full-pass failures, positive-count success paths, and whether both passes always run with initialized state. Verify run-log Tool Failure behavior still matches the old dispatch contract. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-retirement-sweep
archetypes.rationale: The shell helper, harness, and docs were deleted and added to migrated-scripts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the retirement sweep across Makefile, migrated-scripts.tsv, residual-bash-paths.txt, SKILL.md, execution-issues-tracking.md, and deleted helper files. Confirm no live tracked surface still points at the retired .sh or .md paths except the migration manifest. Check that replacement documentation points to python/cli.py, file_oos.py, and pytest coverage. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
